Cat cafe at 370 Mariaville Rd, Rotterdam; every cat is adoptable (cared for by Pretty Paw Rescue). Entry to the cafe is free; lounge visits are $15 per person for 30 minutes or $20 for an hour, booked online or as a walk-in; check FAQ for hours.
